findings.what: Test suite fails at HEAD (1/220): 'disables a weekend day button' uses a fixed today but react-day-picker's 'Today' label uses the host clock; fails in non-UTC TZ (passes with TZ=UTC)
npm run build fails without full env: /staff/login is prerendered and calls getSession, which parses server env; contradicts env.ts comment that build works without env
Public /book booking and slot actions have no rate limiting, though PRD §Clinic.3 requires 'public (rate-limited)'

submitBooking(deps, rawInput) exported from a 'use server' module becomes a callable server action with caller-supplied deps (not exploitable since functions can't be serialized; inconsistent with the reschedule module's pattern)
Custom schedule grid instead of the Schedule-X resource view named in PRD §8.1
Every appointment is 15 minutes regardless of service.duration_minutes
Proxy only checks cookie presence; role enforcement relies entirely on requireStaff in each page/action (documented, but coarse)
